Sandbox_ChangingSkies_EnableAddedWeather: Allows Changing Skies to ask the vanilla weather system to generate additional weather events.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_AddedWeatherFreque: Controls the chance for an added weather event, rolled every 10 in-game minutes. Cooldowns and naturally occurring weather add more time between checks.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_AddedWeatherSeveri: Controls the strength range for ordinary added weather. Vanilla still chooses its generated pattern, stages, type, and duration.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_StormFrequency_too: Controls the chance for a storm. Note: Rolls for a storm are made before normal weather rolls. If both are set to Insane, storms will win every time.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_StormType_tooltip: Selects the storm type. Seasonal chooses based on current season when a storm is rolled. Random chooses a random storm, disregarding the current season.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_StormLength_toolti: Selects the approximate range rolled Storms will be.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_AddedThunderFreque: Controls how often thunder is added.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_AddedThunderScope_: Selects when Added Thunder can play. This does not change thunder created by vanilla weather.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_CooldownMinimumHou: Minimum in-game hours before Changing Skies may add weather after any weather period ends.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_CooldownMaximumHou: Maximum in-game hours before Changing Skies may add weather after any weather period ends.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_EnableTemperatureA: Applies the chosen seasonal temperatures while retaining vanilla daily and weather variation.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SpringColdTargetF_: Sets the Spring low temperature target in °F. Vanilla daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SpringWarmTargetF_: Sets the Spring high temperature target in °F. Vanilla daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SummerColdTargetF_: Sets the Summer low temperature target in °F. Vanilla daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_SummerWarmTargetF_: Sets the Summer high temperature target in °F. Vanilla daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_FallColdTargetF_to: Sets the Fall low temperature target in °F. Vanilla daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_FallWarmTargetF_to: Sets the Fall high temperature target in °F. Vanilla daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_WinterColdTargetF_: Sets the Winter low temperature target in °F. Vanilla daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_WinterWarmTargetF_: Sets the Winter high temperature target in °F. Vanilla daily and weather variation can move beyond it.
Sandbox_ChangingSkies_DebugLogging_toolt: Writes concise scheduler and temperature diagnostics to the game log. Disabled by default.
